description: Repo.rollback/1 throws {Repo, :rollback, reason} (3-tuple, lib/bedrock/internal/repo.ex:204) but run_retryable_transaction only catches {Repo, failed_txn, :rollback, reason} (4-tuple, line 275). No code throws the 4-tuple, so the catch clause is dead and calling MyRepo.rollback/1 inside transact crashes the caller with an uncaught throw instead of rolling back the transaction and returning {:error, reason} as documented in Bedrock.Repo. Found while writing behavioral tests for bedrock-60h.
title: Fix Repo.rollback/1 escaping transact: throw shape mismatch in run_retryable_transaction
